summary: Sottiaux says AI progress shows no sign of slowing, expects broad economic benefits and sees safe deployment and human oversight as key challenges.

statements.quote: We’re able to improve things at crazy speeds, and there’s no sign of it slowing down.
Increasingly this will become a multi-agent system and it’ll become more and more capable. You’ll have to figure out how to steer and supervise its outcome and its behavior.
Revolutionizing how software is built also means being part of something that will generate incredible economic value and real benefits for humanity.
What we have seen is a shift from big teams to small teams that are able to leverage more and more intelligence.
The true bottleneck was how we deploy this safely into the world in a new way.
